edition: MICHELIN Guide Northeast Cities 2025: New York selection (New York City and Westchester County)
announced_note: Ceremony held the evening of Nov 18, 2025 at the Kimmel Center, Philadelphia (Michelin press release posted Nov 18; Time Out and Fine Dining Lovers reported it on Nov 19). No 2026 New York selection has been announced as of 2026-10-07: Michelin set the 2026 Northeast Cities ceremony for Dec 14, 2026 in New York.
counts_note: Stars (5 three-star, 15 two-star, 52 one-star) are Michelin's own 2025 Northeast Cities starred list (press release a1442, list images), filtered to New York addresses; they match Wikipedia's 2025 column. Bib Gourmands: Michelin's press release lists only the 9 new NY Bibs; the full NY list was built from Michelin's official 2024 NY Bib list (91, press release a1383) minus the 8 that Wikipedia's 2025 column shows dropped or closed, plus the 9 new ones = 88, matching Wikipedia's 2025 count. Michelin's own article reports 90 NY Bibs for 2025 (seen only as a search-result snippet of guide.michelin.com, which we may not fetch), so 2 of the 4 Westchester 2024 Bibs that Wikipedia does not track (listed in bib_unconfirmed_2025) were probably retained, but we could not confirm which. Two 2025 Bibs (Atla, Bayon) have since closed and are in closed_since, not in restaurants. Recommended: no per-city count or complete list was published on an allowed source (the press release gives only Northeast totals: 6 three-star, 22 two-star, 93 one-star, 9 Green Star, 166 Bib, 377 Recommended, 664 total; and it lists only the 31 NY Recommended restaurants that were new in 2025). For reference the 2024 NY selection had 5/14/55 stars, 91 Bibs, 220 Recommended, 385 total (press release a1383). The brief's ~231 Recommended was not verified. green_star is 0 because MICHELIN retired the Green Star worldwide from June 1, 2026 (replaced by the non-award Mindful Voices platform).
scope_note: Every 2025 NY Star, Bib Gourmand and new Recommended address is in the five boroughs or Westchester County (Westchester: Tarrytown/Pocantico Hills, North Salem, and the Bib towns). No MICHELIN New York selection was found upstate or on Long Island.

special_awards_2025_ny.award: MICHELIN Young Chef / Culinary Professional Award

green_star_history.note: Held a MICHELIN Green Star in the 2025 Northeast Cities edition; the Green Star was retired worldwide from June 1, 2026, so it is not shown. One White Street had a Green Star without a Star or Bib.
